name: JCC Camp Deeny Riback
description_short: JCC MetroWest day camp on 35 wooded acres in Flanders for ages 3 and a half to grade 10, with two heated pools, Budd Lake waterfront, ropes courses and a zip line, sports, arts, cooking and Jewish programming. Bus service from Essex and Morris towns and kosher lunch are included.
special_needs_notes: Camp Friends inclusion program for campers with mild to moderate needs in PreK to grade 7, with a one to one advocate counselor; interview and acceptance required.
notes: Divisions: Junior Village (entering PreK to 1), Middle Camp (2 to 5), Upper Camp (6 to 9), Leaders in Training (10). Families choose 2 to 8 weeks, first two consecutive; optional week 9 for younger divisions. Dismissal 4 pm. $750 deposit, refundable through January 1 less $200. Central bus stops in Essex and Morris counties, including Montclair, Maplewood, South Orange, Livingston, West Orange, Millburn, Summit, Morristown and Parsippany. All food is kosher and nut free.
